text:
ashley: Acme POC seeing intermittent 429s during a parallel upload test ~45s in. logs (redacted): https://acme-demo.logs/recent

samir: can you paste the exact error + headers? 429 can be per-route RPM or token-rate.

acme-agent: "{\"error\":\"Too many requests\",\"status\":429}"
Headers: x-ratelimit-limit: 60, x-ratelimit-remaining: 0, x-ratelimit-reset: 13

miguel (oncall): default /v1/generate short-window=60rpm. Were they starting many parallel workers?

ashley: yes 1 workers? actually 8 concurrent agents each ~1 req/s for ~1 minute. payloads ~1200 tokens avg.

jia: quick calc: 8 workers * ~60s -> ~480 requests in window; per-route 60rpm will cap them long before monthly token budget.

rate-limiter-bot: Quota for org "acme-corp": monthly_token_budget=5,000,000; tokens_used_mtd=1,100,432; per_minute_token_rate_limit=20000; per_route_requests_per_minute(/v1/generate)=60.

miguel: sales asked for temporary bump: /v1/generate -> 120 rpm and 30000 tokens/min. Can we do targeted bump?

samir: running CLI update:
redwoodctl quotas update --org acme-corp --route /v1/generate --rpm 120 --token-rate 30000 --note "trial bump for Acme POC"
(Change q-97321)

rate-limiter-bot: Policy apply succeeded for org "acme-corp" (q-97321). New per-route rpm=120, token_rate=30000 tokens/min.

acme-agent: reran test, small spike still:
[2026-04-19T15:42:03Z] POST /v1/generate 200 1180 tokens
[2026-04-19T15:42:04Z] POST /v1/generate 429 x-ratelimit-remaining:0

miguel: likely window-edge race on propagation. Recommend burst allowance to smooth parallel startup.

jia: propose burst_capacity=300 over 30s and remind client to use jittered backoff.

samir: applying burst patch:
redwoodctl quotas patch --org acme-corp --route /v1/generate --burst_capacity 300 --burst_window 30
(Change q-97322)

rate-limiter-bot: Burst policy updated for org "acme-corp" (q-97322). burst_capacity=300, burst_window=30s.

acme-agent: re-ran; "errors dropped to near zero, huge improvement" :tada:

miguel: SRE note for playbook: for POCs with parallel workers start rpm=120-200, token-rate=25k-50k tokens/min, burst_capacity=200-400/30s. Advise client-side jittered exponential backoff.

jia: filing INF-4521 to add a sales-friendly quota bump template + auto-expiry audit.

samir: changes q-97321,q-97322 recorded; auto-expire in 7 days unless extended.

ashley: will follow up if they ask to extend. marking resolved from sales side, monitoring for 2 hours. thanks all!
